meta.name: dashboard
meta.description: Review the portfolio across existing engagement records. Use for status across customers; requires accessible permitted records and does not create missing client histories.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把每位客户的服务进展汇成一张总览,随时看清当前状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时服务多位客户,需要随时掌握各自的进展
copy.tagline_en: See every client's engagement status pulled together in one overview
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you serve several clients and need a quick read on each one's status

howto.what: 它会读取已有的客户往来记录,汇总各客户的进展状态,并区分实现、验证、部署与验收。缺失或无权访问的记录会如实报为限制。
howto.when: 当你想了解多个客户的整体状态时触发;前提是有可访问且有权限的记录。若由 @fde 调用,则直接复用其现有脱敏数据包和范围。

say.text: 看一下目前各客户的整体状态
say.note: 基于已有记录汇总,缺口会说明

say.text: 哪些客户的记录缺失或没有权限访问?
@fde 继续,用现有数据包看状态
say.note: 复用当前范围,不重新开始

howto.what_en: It reviews existing engagement records and summarizes status across customers, distinguishing implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance. Missing or inaccessible records are reported as a limitation instead of being created.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want status across customers, given accessible permitted records. When called by @fde, it reuses that run's sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or questions.

say_en.text: Show me the current status across all customers
Which customer records are missing or not accessible?
@fde continue - review status from the current packet
say_en.note: Reuses the existing scope, no restart
